project_title: Transformer-Based Classification of Contract Clause Themes for ICM Solutions Knowledge Reuse
task: 10-class single-label text classification of expert-annotated CUAD contract clause passages

dataset.split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold with 10 folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42; folds 0-7 train, 8 validation, 9 test
dataset.split_reason: Preserves contract-level separation while balancing clause categories across splits.
dataset.tokenization: Lowercase regex word-and-punctuation tokenizer; vocabulary fit on training split only

model.architecture: Custom Transformer encoder classifier trained from scratch

training_common.checkpoint_rule: highest validation macro F1; ties resolved by lower validation loss

evaluation.primary_metric: macro F1 on untouched test split

integrity_controls: No contract appears in more than one split.
Vocabulary is built from training text only.
Validation data selects checkpoints; test data is evaluated once after both configurations are frozen.
The same folds, vocabulary, batches, seed procedure, epochs, optimizer, learning rate, and checkpoint rule are used for both configurations.
No confidential ICM or client data is used.
